== Biography ==
Abraham was born in 1719. He is the son of [[Glasgow-1226|Thomas Glasgow]] and [[Clarkson-2169|Catherine Clarkson]]. 

He married 17 December 1741 at Livingston, Linlithgowshire, Scotland, [[Cunnyngham-118|Janet Cunnyngham]].<ref>"Scotland Marriages, 1561-1910", database, FamilySearch (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XY7B-CZV : 11 February 2020), Abraham Glasgow, 1741.</ref>
